blurb: Callville Bay Marina offers houseboat rentals, pontoon boats, ski boats, and Mako fish skiffs for day trips or extended stays on Lake Mead. Houseboats include options sleeping 6 to 10 guests with amenities like kitchens, TV/DVD players, and canopied top decks. The marina is open seasonally and provides RV sites and boat slips.
